title: Effective syntax for order-invariant first-order queries

import_provenance.original_title: An effective syntax for order-invariant first-order queries
import_provenance.original_statement: Is there an effectively presented logic defining exactly the queries expressible by first-order formulas with an auxiliary linear order whose choice does not affect the result? This is an editorial continuation of Gurevich’s work showing that order-invariant first-order logic can express more than ordinary first-order logic.
